newsitem.title: USA: Alpharma gets FDA nod to sell Acyclovir.
newsitem.headline: Alpharma gets FDA nod to sell Acyclovir.

text.p: Alpharma Inc said Tuesday it has received approval from the Food and Drug Administration to manufacture and market Acyclovir Oral Suspension.

Acyclovir, said the company, is the generic equivalent of Zovirax produced by Glaxo Wellcome Plc and is used in the treatment of genital herpes, shingles and chickenpox. The patent on Zovirax expired a few days ago, Alpharma said.
The latest addition to Alpharma's anti-viral category of liquid pharmaceutical products, Acyclovir Oral Suspension will be marketed exclusively by its U.S. Pharmaceuticals division.
The company added that although certain tablet and capsule companies have announced the launch of generic Acyclovir equivalents, Alpharma presently has the only liquid application in this market.
Alpharma manufactures and markets specialty generic and proprietary human pharmaceuticals and animal health products.
